claims.disproof_condition: 條件：聯亞的年報或法說不再列「製程後磷化銦磊晶片」（再成長）產品，或其他商用磊晶廠在一手文件寫出高功率埋入式或光柵 DFB 的 CW 雷射磊晶片量產並具名客戶。核查頻率：每季（聯亞與各家財報、法說）＋每年（年報）。觸發後 48 小時：本 claim 加註，InP 磊晶片層讀圖重讀供給側。
claims.statement: LandMark lists 'Regrown InP Epi-wafer' as its own product group (RWG-DFB, BH-FP/DFB, photodetector) and says it does DFB grating fabrication and multiple epitaxial growth itself. Variant-level capability claim by the supplier (L8: self-report); which customers use which variant is not disclosed.

claims.disproof_condition: 條件：聯亞年報的競爭段不再寫 IDM 把部分磊晶製程外包，或它的主要客戶表中 2025 年因資料中心長出來的客戶占比腰斬。核查頻率：每年（聯亞年報）。觸發後 48 小時：本 claim 加註，聯亞敘事「我們賭什麼」重寫。
claims.statement: LandMark says IDMs frequently face internal capacity constraints and gradually outsource certain epitaxial processes to it. Supplier description of its customers' motive (L8: weak); customers are disclosed only by code.
